## Change checklist

- [ ] I linked the work to one or more task IDs from `tasks.md`.
- [ ] I recorded validation evidence and a safe restart point in `CONTINUITY.md`.
- [ ] Public strings use translation keys or approved CMS content.
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, semantic HTML, contrast, zoom/reflow, and reduced-motion behavior were checked.
- [ ] Analytics is consent-aware and contains no prohibited personal or payment data.
- [ ] Prices, availability, finance, legal terms, and product claims are from approved sources or fail safely.
- [ ] New external input is runtime-validated and new mutations are server-side, auditable, and idempotent where required.
